definitions.explanation: A natural elevation of land that is lower and more gently sloped than a mountain. Often used in geographical and descriptive contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦なだらか→なだらか：19406_nadaraka⟧な{丘陵|きゅうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Gentle hills spread out before us.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{丘陵|きゅうりょう}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ブドウ{畑|ばたけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many vineyards in this hilly area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住宅地|じゅうたくち}→住宅地：10158_juutakuchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丘陵|きゅうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{開|ひら}いて→切り開く：05745_kirihiraku⟧⟦{造|つく}られた→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The residential area was created by clearing the hills.

notes:
A geographical term more formal than ⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧ (hill). Used in geography, real estate, and descriptive writing. Japan has many {丘陵|きゅうりょう}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧ (hilly areas), and the term appears frequently in place names and urban development descriptions.

FORMS:
{丘|きゅう} (hill) + {陵|りょう} (mound, hill)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丘陵|きゅうりょう}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧: hilly area, hill country
- {丘陵|きゅうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{開|ひら}く→切り開く：05745_kirihiraku⟧: to clear/develop hills
- ⟦なだらか→なだらか：19406_nadaraka⟧な{丘陵|きゅうりょう}: gentle hills
- {丘陵|きゅうりょう}{地|ち}: hilly land

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧: hill — everyday word, smaller and more specific than {丘陵|きゅうりょう}
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧: mountain — taller and steeper
- {台地|だいち}: plateau, tableland — elevated but flat on top
